## Pre-merge Checklist

- [ ] Code follows existing patterns and conventions
- [ ] No emojis in code, comments, or UI text
- [ ] All database queries are organization-scoped
- [ ] No `.env`, credentials, or secrets committed
- [ ] Tests pass: `docker exec ecommerce_app php artisan test`
- [ ] Code formatted: `docker exec ecommerce_app ./vendor/bin/pint`
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Migration is safe for zero-downtime deploy (if applicable)
